_id: freq rung: ism915_2450. LICENCE-EXEMPT band pair -- 915 MHz (ITU Region 2 ISM 902-928 MHz) paired with 2.45 GHz (ISM 2400-2500 MHz). Both carriers move, unlike freq001-008 which only ever shift L2 inside the protected GPS L-band. MEASURED CONSEQUENCES OF THE BAND CHOICE (computed, not assumed): first-order ionospheric delay scales as 1/f^2, so this pair sees 0.4135 x the L1 ionosphere on the high carrier and 2.9645 x on the low one; the ionosphere-free combination of this pair would amplify uncorrelated code noise by 1.173 x, against 2.975 x for GPS L1/L2 -- IF amplification follows FRACTIONAL separation, and this pair is 91.2% apart against L1/L2's 22.0%. Carrier wavelengths are 122.364 mm and 327.642 mm. SPECTRUM: 26 MHz and 100 MHz of allocation respectively. HELD FIXED ON PURPOSE: codeSigma0_m stays at the golden 0.30 / 0.45 m. A higher carrier does not by itself sharpen the code -- ranging noise follows chip rate and bandwidth, not carrier frequency -- so letting it fall with band would bake in the conclusion. This run is raw dual frequency with the golden's per-tower slant-iono state, i.e. the freq002 configuration with the band moved.
